worldcombat.skill.flatter.summary: Flatters the target and confuses it; this also raises the target's Special Attack.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.use.1: Pin an opponent the instant before it closes in
worldcombat.skill.flatter.use.2: Add fuel to an already faltering enemy
worldcombat.skill.flatter.description.0: Flatter the target senseless: it gains %1$s Special Attack stages and is pinned for %2$s s, confused for about %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.description.1: While flattered, each attempt has a %1$s%% chance to be lost in a daze; when it lands a hit on an enemy it takes recoil for about %2$s%% of its maximum health (further scaled by its current Special Attack).
worldcombat.skill.flatter.description.2: Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s, range %4$s blocks. A rapid patter adds to the gift, the fumble chance and the pin but shortens the daze and deepens the recoil; a slow tribute does the opposite.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.timing: Short windup and recovery; accurate and single target, paced by its cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.preference.ton: Rapid patter: gift +1 stage, fumble chance +12%%, longer pin, but daze x0.7 and recoil x1.3. Slow tribute: daze x1.35 and recoil x0.7, for a long grind.
Only consider flattering a threat within this distance; larger opens earlier.
Prefer to flatter while the target is still this far away, using its daze to open space; closer targets only follow the normal order.
When on, the companion leaves its post to flatter.
